mapper.sql: FROM ELIB_COMMENT WHERE book_idx = #{book_idx} ORDER BY add_date DESC
mapper.select: SELECT a.comment_idx, TO_CHAR(a.add_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS add_date, a.book_idx, a.user_idx, a.member_id, a.user_comment, b.book_name, b.author_name, b.book_pubname, (SELECT z.cate_name FROM ELIB_CATEGORY z WHERE z.cate_id = b.cate_id) AS cate_name, (SELECT z.cate_name FROM ELIB_CATEGORY z WHERE z.cate_id = b.parent_id) AS parent_name FROM ELIB_COMMENT a, ELIB_BOOK b WHERE 1=1 AND a.book_idx = b.book_idx AND a.comment_idx = #{comment_idx}

${pagingTop} SELECT a.comment_idx, TO_CHAR(a.add_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS add_date, a.book_idx, a.user_idx, a.member_id, a.user_comment, b.book_name, b.author_name, b.book_pubname, (SELECT z.cate_name FROM ELIB_CATEGORY z WHERE z.cate_id = b.cate_id) AS cate_name, (SELECT z.cate_name FROM ELIB_CATEGORY z WHERE z.cate_id = b.parent_id) AS parent_name, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(z.lend_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM ELIB_LEND z WHERE z.lend_idx = ( SELECT MAX(lend_idx) FROM ELIB_LEND z WHERE z.member_id = a.member_id AND z.book_idx = a.book_idx ) ) AS last_lend_dt, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(z.return_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM ELIB_LEND z WHERE z.lend_idx = ( SELECT MAX(lend_idx) FROM ELIB_LEND z WHERE z.member_id = a.member_id AND z.book_idx = a.book_idx ) ) AS last_return_dt
ORDER BY a.add_date DESC ${pagingBottom}

SELECT a.comment_idx, TO_CHAR(a.add_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS add_date, a.book_idx, a.user_idx, a.member_id, a.user_comment, b.book_name, b.author_name, b.book_pubname, (SELECT z.cate_name FROM ELIB_CATEGORY z WHERE z.cate_id = b.cate_id) AS cate_name, (SELECT z.cate_name FROM ELIB_CATEGORY z WHERE z.cate_id = b.parent_id) AS parent_name, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(z.lend_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM ELIB_LEND z WHERE z.lend_idx = ( SELECT MAX(lend_idx) FROM ELIB_LEND z WHERE z.member_id = a.member_id AND z.book_idx = a.book_idx ) ) AS last_lend_dt, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(z.return_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM ELIB_LEND z WHERE z.lend_idx = ( SELECT MAX(lend_idx) FROM ELIB_LEND z WHERE z.member_id = a.member_id AND z.book_idx = a.book_idx ) ) AS last_return_dt
ORDER BY a.add_date DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ELIB_COMMENT WHERE comment_idx = #{comment_idx} AND member_id = #{member_id}
